questions.title: Time Interval Progression
questions.question: Look at the clock times: 1:00, 3:00, 5:00, 7:00, ? Which time comes next?
questions.explanation: The time goes up by exactly 2 hours each step.

questions.title: Number Gap Progression
questions.question: Look at this number pattern: 3, 6, 11, 18, 27, ? What number comes next?
questions.explanation: The gaps are +3, +5, +7, +9. The next gap is +11, so 27 + 11 = 38.

questions.title: Alternating Output Pattern
questions.question: Look at this output pattern: 10, 5, 15, 10, 20, ? What comes next?
questions.explanation: The pattern goes minus 5, then plus 10. The last step was plus 10, so next is minus 5. 20 - 5 = 15.

questions.title: Delivery Drone Routing
questions.question: A delivery drone must drop packages at locations A, B, and C. Rule 1: B must be visited before C. Rule 2: A must be visited last. What is the only valid route?
questions.explanation: Only this route follows both rules at the same time.

questions.title: Irrigation System Conditionals
questions.question: An irrigation rule says: "Activate IF (Soil is Dry) AND (Weather is NOT Raining)." Under which condition will it water the garden?

options.C: Dry soil, Cloudy but not raining

questions.explanation: Both conditions are met: the soil is dry and it is not raining.

questions.title: Permission Contrapositive
questions.question: The rule is: "If a user is a Teacher, they have permission to delete files." Which statement must be true?

options.A: Delete permission means the user is a Teacher.
options.B: A user who cannot delete files is not a Teacher.

questions.explanation: This is the contrapositive of the original rule (if not delete, then not Teacher), so it is always true.

questions.title: HTML Hyperlinks
questions.question: Which tag makes a link to another web page?
questions.explanation: The <a> tag makes a link. Its href attribute holds the address.

questions.title: CSS Paragraph Color
questions.question: Which CSS rule changes the text color of paragraphs to blue?
questions.explanation: p picks the paragraphs. color sets the text color.

questions.title: Python List Creation
questions.question: Which line creates a list in Python?
questions.explanation: Square brackets make a list. Round brackets make a tuple. Curly brackets make a set.

questions.title: Java Increment Operator
questions.explanation: x++ adds 1 to x. So x becomes 6.

questions.title: Java Boolean Data Type
questions.question: Which data type is used to store only true or false values?
questions.explanation: A boolean holds only true or false.

questions.title: JavaScript Click Events
questions.question: Which HTML attribute runs JavaScript code when a user clicks a button?
questions.explanation: onclick runs when an element is clicked.

questions.title: C++ Address-of Operator
questions.question: In C++, which symbol gets the memory address of a variable?
questions.explanation: The & (address-of) operator gives a variable's memory address.

questions.title: Python Dictionary Key Access
questions.question: Look at this Python dictionary: user = {"name": "Alex", "age": 17}. How do you get "Alex"?
questions.explanation: Dictionary values are read using their key in square brackets.

questions.title: Java Object Creation
questions.question: In Java, a class named Dog already exists. Which line creates a Dog object?
questions.explanation: The new keyword creates an object. Dog d = new Dog(); stores it in d.
